intro: We list {{count}} government MBA / PGDM programme options across {{colleges}} public institutes in West Bengal. The page is for students comparing the best government MBA colleges in West Bengal by recorded average package.
IIT Kharagpur and IIM Calcutta dominate the top of the list. They lead the top MBA colleges in West Bengal 2026, with university and NIT programmes following by package.
listLead: IIM Calcutta accounts for 23 of the {{count}} rows, and IIT Kharagpur for 7, so the same institute can appear under more than one programme. Match the programme name with the official brochure.
snapshot: Among these {{colleges}} public colleges, the median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, from placement years {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
Recorded averages run from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. The highest single figure we hold is {{highestMax}}, which sits well above the median.
Most of these colleges use CAT. NIT Durgapur's placement year in our file is 2016, so that row is a poor guide to current outcomes.
firstCollegesLead: IIM Calcutta is 7th and IIT Kharagpur is 12th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. Our 2023 record for IIM Calcutta's PGP shows an average of ₹29 LPA and a highest of ₹45 LPA.
IIT Kharagpur's PGDBA row for 2023 shows an average of ₹31 LPA and a highest of ₹52 LPA. Its MBA Finance row for 2024 shows ₹21 LPA and ₹37 LPA. These are different programmes.

sections.heading: Reading NIRF ranks beside this West Bengal list
paragraphs: The official NIRF 2025 Management ranks for IIM Calcutta (7th) and IIT Kharagpur (12th) differ from some older numbers on our cards. Use the 2025 list when you cite a rank, and use each programme's own placement report for pay.

compare.heading: How to compare the best government MBA colleges in West Bengal
paragraphs: A PGP at IIM Calcutta, an MBA or PGDBA at IIT Kharagpur, and a university MBA in Midnapore or Kolkata serve different applicants.
bullets: The exact programme behind the average — PGP, MBA, PGDBA or a specialised course.
The placement year, especially where our file still shows 2016 data.
The full fee and whether hostel and mess are included.
The city (Kharagpur, Kolkata, Durgapur, Howrah or Darjeeling) and the entrance test used.

faqs.question: How many government MBA colleges in West Bengal are listed here?
faqs.answer: We hold {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} public institutes. IIM Calcutta and IIT Kharagpur appear many times because we hold several of their programmes.

faqs.question: What average packages do these colleges report?
faqs.answer: The median recorded average is {{pkgMedian}}, with recorded averages from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. The median is pulled down by several university programmes that sit near {{pkgMin}}.

faqs.question: What are the NIRF 2025 ranks for IIM Calcutta and IIT Kharagpur?
faqs.answer: In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Calcutta is 7th and IIT Kharagpur is 12th. Use those ranks rather than any older number on a card.

faqs.question: Is Salesian College a government college?
faqs.answer: It is listed as public in our records, which may mean it is government-aided. Confirm the management type and fee on the college's official site before you treat it as a public university.

faqs.question: Should I rely on NIT Durgapur's package figure?
faqs.answer: Only as a historical marker. Our placement year for NIT Durgapur is 2016. Ask the institute for its latest official MBA placement report.
